summary.text: Brach Myers is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 23, representing Lafayette, according to the Senate member page.
The page lists 2025 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The Senate member page lists Brach Myers's education as Opelousas Catholic High School, 1999; University of Louisiana Lafayette, Credits to Incomplete Program, 2004; Center for Creative Leadership, LDP Program, 2012; Harvard Business School Online (Actively Enrolled).
The Senate member page lists Brach Myers's committee assignments as Environmental Quality; Insurance; Labor and Industrial Relations; Retirement.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
